_about: Stage 26, staff lives. Every colleague has a few needs (rest, money, family, pride, ambition) that drift from day to day, and a goal of their own. On a day with room for it, the colleague whose need is loudest walks up to the doctor on Ward 4 and asks for something (the conversation is in story/lives.json). What the doctor says is remembered: a message some days later says how it went, and it changes how they treat the doctor afterwards. An arc only starts when it can finish before the story jumps ahead in time. Read by Lives.

payoff.text: I got in. Vellore. It's weekends, so you're stuck with me on weekdays. Sorry. Don't tell anyone yet. Okay, tell Grace. She probably knows already. She knows everything.
Went for the interview anyway. Took a sick day. I was sick. Of nights. They said they'll let me know. That's code for no, right?
They offered. I said no. Manipal gave her a scholarship, and I realised I'd miss shouting swab count. Keep the letter. Frame it.
They said your letter was refreshingly honest. Then they hired someone else. Manipal gave her a scholarship anyway. So. Swab count forever.
Fine. I'm staying. Manipal gave her a scholarship. You owe me one samosa a day. For life.
Ate a whole thali yesterday. The dal was mid but I felt things. Thank you for the bleep. Core memory.
Fainted in the lift. Only for like four seconds. The liftman gave me a mango drink and a lecture. Both were valid.
Dr. Iyer gave me Sunday off and a look. The look was worse. The sleep was elite though.
Thank you for coming. My aunt wants to know who the doctor was who ate two plates of biryani and left in twenty minutes because of a page. She's not angry. She's disappointed. Same thing.
We missed you. You missed three kinds of biryani. I saved you a box. It's in the anaesthetic room fridge. Don't tell infection control.
My mother has decided you're her favourite doctor. She has never met you. She says anyone who covers my clinic has sense. She's sending laddoos. Do not eat them all.
Sorted it on the phone. She acquitted the nurses. I'm still on probation.
Cleared it. Your coeliac trunk question came up. I will never admit you helped. This message will self-destruct.
Missed it by four marks. Four. The lemon and the chillies let me down.
Didn't clear it. Taking a break. Not because you said so. Because the universe did.
